correctness.rationale: Plancherel and the same-sign quadrant multiplier give the exact kernel identity. Since \(0\le J(s)\le s\) and \(J(s)/s\to1\), dominated convergence gives the finite half-Sobolev limit and Fatou gives divergence outside the half-Sobolev class. For finitely many jumps, the distributional derivative has a finite atomic part; diagonal atomic terms contribute the logarithmic coefficient and off-diagonal terms are oscillatory lower order. The constants reduce correctly to the hard interval cutoff.
